title: AutoPass — auto end turn
description:
Automatically ends your turn the moment you have no possible actions left: no playable card in hand (energy, 0-cost, X-cost, star costs and card restrictions all respected via the game's own logic) and no potion you'd want to drink.

Also auto-resolves pointless card selections: fixed-count prompts (Survivor/Prepared-style "discard exactly N") skip the selection screen entirely when every eligible card is functionally identical — same upgrade, enchantment, counters, cost and state. Anything differs and you get the normal screen. (Single-player only.)

F8 toggles AutoPass anywhere, including mid-fight, with an on-screen indicator — handy for drinking a potion (e.g. Fortifier) after your last card. Toggling on with nothing left to do passes the turn immediately.

Configure it in the game's own Mods screen (select AutoPass in the mod list):
- Auto-end turn: on/off (F8 anywhere)
- Auto-pick identical selection cards: on/off
- Potions block auto-pass: Always (default) / Elites & bosses only / Never

'Elites & bosses only' auto-passes hallway fights while you hoard potions, but never ends your turn holding a usable potion in elite/boss fights — including honorary elites like the Mysterious Knight (Lantern Key). Drink potions before playing your last card, or use F8.

Never fires while effects or queued actions are still resolving (Unceasing Top draws are safe). Multiplayer-safe: only ever presses YOUR end turn button, through the game's own code path. Marked as not affecting gameplay.

Source: https://github.com/bradfordseipp/sts2-autopass
